visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of tour/product cards: image, two-line title, pill CTA, description
visualCharacteristics.description: 4 dark cards: DM personalised overlay image, two-line title, pill CTA, description | Dark vertical cards: personalised DM image, two-line title, pill CTA above description

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = card image (picture, image link or bare Scene7 templated URL, kept as-is); cell 2 = title paragraph (first paragraph, may contain a line break), a paragraph with a single CTA link, then description
contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike items that flow and wrap

usage: Bookable tours or products shown as vertical cards with a call to action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for product/offer cards with a CTA. For image tiles with only a caption use cards-caption-overlay.
